title: Poder, deber, and preferir
explanation:
Poder, deber, and preferir are followed by an infinitive when the sentence is about an action. Puedo hablar means I can speak. Debo estudiar means I must study. Preferir can also take a noun: prefiero el café.

The yo and tú forms change the stem. Puedo, puedes, puede. Debo, debes, debe. Prefiero, prefieres, prefiere. In Spain, juice is zumo.
commonMistake: Conjugating the second verb. The second verb stays in the infinitive: puedo hablar, not puedo hablo.
